description.zh:
給定三個正整數 \( m \)、\( n \) 和 \( r \)， \( m \) 行 \( n \) 個元素，給予一個 \( m \times n \) 矩陣 \( A \)，並且 \( n \) 行 \( r \) 個元素，給予一個 \( n \times r \) 矩陣 \( B \)， 形成乘積矩陣 \( A B \)，即 \( m \times r \) 矩陣 其中 \( (i,k) \) 條目是總和 $$ A[i][1] * B[1][k] + \cdots + A[i][n] * B[n][k] $$ 並列印結果。

C++ 注意：對於二維陣列使用 vector>。第一個索引是行，第二個索引是列。
description.en:
Given three positive integers \( m \), \( n \) and \( r \), \( m \) lines of \( n \) elements, giving an \( m \times n \) matrix \( A \), and \( n \) lines of \( r \) elements, giving an \( n \times r \) matrix \( B \), form the product matrix \( A B \), which is the \( m \times r \) matrix whose \( (i,k) \) entry is the sum $$ A[i][1] * B[1][k] + \cdots + A[i][n] * B[n][k] $$ and print the result.

C++ note: Use vector<vector<int>> for a two-dimensional array. The first index is the row and the second is the column.

hint.zh: Python 二維 list 在此章對應 vector<vector<int>>；第一個索引是列，第二個索引是欄。
hint.en: Use vector<vector<int>> for a two-dimensional array. The first index is the row and the second is the column.
